title: CONNECT-UDP HTTP/1.1 Upgrade Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 HTTP/1.1 CONNECT-UDP upgrade request and response policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpHttp11UpgradePolicy` builds and validates HTTP/1.1 CONNECT-UDP upgrade request/response fields: GET, single Host, Connection: Upgrade, Upgrade: connect-udp, 101 Switching Protocols, no message content, malformed 400 recommendation, failed-attempt abort decision, and required HTTP setting marker.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is header/status policy only. It does not own TCP connection state or start a live Capsule stream.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Connection upgrade tokens are compared case-insensitively.
Request and response content is rejected.
Duplicate Host or Upgrade fields are rejected where the RFC requires a single field.
risks: Live HTTP/1.1 connection upgrade handling remains adapter work.
Actual Capsule stream I/O remains in the tunnel forwarding slice.
